## Root cause (the confident-wrong defect)

The Plan 03 cross-scope fallback AUTO-resolved to the winner's **`root_party_id`** (the
parent company) instead of the matching **leaf `party_id`** (the actually-invoiced
debtor). Every reachable bucket-C confident-wrong was the ROOT of the correct leaf:

| invoice (#) | scope_key | leaf party_id | party_name | root_party_id | GT | pre-fix returned |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 33050903 (#98) | SF | BX**524156** | De Studio | BX524011 | 524156 | 524011 (root) ❌ |
| 33050837 (#12) | SF | BX**527773** | Fedasil Koksijde | BX499559 | 527773 | 499559 (root) ❌ |
| 33051109 (#38) | SF | BX**530964** | Jumbo Supermarkten BV | BX522781 | 530964 | 522781 (root) ❌ |
| 33050611 (#96) | SF | BX**510711** | VZW Familia | (null) | 510711 | 510711 (leaf) ✅ |

#96 was correct ONLY because its party has a null root (leaf == root). Secondary
defect: `resolver_index` has **no brand_id column** — the brand/scope lives in
`scope_key`. On the live substrate `brand_id` is null, so (a) the `cross_scope_misroute`
annotation (keyed on `brand_id`) never fired, and (b) the in-scope-vs-cross-scope gate in
`identifier-match.ts` mis-classified a null-brand cross-scope row as in-scope and
AUTO-resolved it to the ROOT via the original in-scope path.

## The fix (code-only, Plan 05)

1. `cross-scope.ts` — AUTO + degrade shortlist surface the winning **leaf** `party_id`;
   `root_party_id` is used ONLY for the distinctness/uniqueness bar (D-08).
2. `cross-scope.ts` — `misrouteAnnotation` falls back to `scope_key` when `brand_id` is
   absent (brand_id still wins when present → no behaviour change there).
3. `identifier-match.ts` — in-scope-vs-cross detection keys on `scope_key` when
   `brand_id` is null, routing null-brand cross-scope rows into the cross-scope post-pass.

## Out-of-scope finding — #95 (NOT a regression)

#95 resolves to `524156` (the De Studio leaf) at high, but its ground-truth is
`525156` (a sibling/different party). #95 was confident-wrong BEFORE the fix
(`524011`, the root of 524156) AND after (`524156`, the leaf) — the leaf-vs-root fix
moved it from root-wrong to leaf-wrong; neither matches GT. #95 belongs to the
ORIGINAL 4 confident-wrong AUTO rows (#2/#85/#95/#97), a different root cause (a
sibling-party / invoice→party mapping defect in `resolver_index`), and is explicitly
outside the Plan 05 reachable bucket-C target set (#98/#12/#38 + #96 control). Logged
to `deferred-items.md` for a follow-up.

## Timeout caveat (do NOT count as failures)

The harness hits the LIVE `nxt.resolve_candidates` Zap. The `nxt-zap-client` 20s client
timeout can flip a row to `unresolved`/`none` even though Zapier itself succeeds (cold
cache on the first tick). On the first run all four targets timed out; **re-running the
timed-out rows WARM** resolved them deterministically to the correct leaf. A `none`
verdict produced by a `nxt lookup timed out after 20000ms` log line is a transport
timeout, NOT a resolver verdict — re-run warm before scoring.
